name: Siobhan Leyden
title: Broadcast journalist and media relations specialist
bio_short: Broadcast journalist with more than 15 years' experience in media, journalism and PR. Former presenter at Dubai One, Dubai Eye and Channel 4 News. Senior PR and media relations roles with Gulf News and Abu Dhabi National Exhibitions.
bio: Siobhan is a broadcast journalist with more than 15 years' experience in media, journalism and PR. Her broadcasting career began in 2001, and she has since worked as a researcher, producer, presenter and reporter for television and radio, including roles at Dubai One, Dubai Eye, Channel 4 News and BBC Radio Five Live. Her career has also included senior PR and media relations positions with Gulf News and Abu Dhabi National Exhibitions Company.  This combination of broadcast journalism and corporate PR gives Siobhan a dual perspective on media relations. She understands how newsrooms operate, what makes a story and how journalists make editorial decisions, but she also understands the pressures and priorities of the organisations seeking media coverage. She has managed media campaigns, organised press conferences and positioned brands and events across the UAE media landscape.  At ISOC, Siobhan delivers corporate communications, media training and media relations programmes. Her experience in both the newsroom and the press office makes her particularly effective at preparing participants for media engagement and helping organisations develop media relations strategies that achieve their communication objectives. She is well versed in the UAE media landscape and the specific dynamics of regional media. Siobhan is based in Dubai and trains in English.
